turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: Over the past few months I’ve noticed stiffness in my arm, and it’s become harder to comb my hair and reach items on high shelves. My shoulder range of motion is reduced and my arm feels a bit weaker—about 4 out of 5.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your symptoms, have you experienced any changes in your vision, such as blurriness, blind spots, or any loss of sight?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my vision—no blurriness, blind spots, or loss of sight.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t smoke and I don’t have a history of smoking.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had nausea or felt sick to my stomach.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area, and nothing has been painful.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can sometimes be linked to how we are feeling emotionally. To help me get a clearer picture of your overall well-being, have you been experiencing a significant amount of psychological stress lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been under significant psychological stress lately. My main issue is the progressive stiffness and reduced range of motion in my arm and shoulder, which makes daily activities like combing my hair and reaching high shelves harder.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your current health, could you tell me if you have noticed any changes in the color of your urine, specifically if it has appeared darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any change in the color of my urine—no particular darkening.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, have you noticed if the mass has been growing or changing in size rapidly?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast lumps or any change in size—nothing like that at all.”

turns.doctor_question: Hello. I'm here to help you understand what might be going on with your health today. To get started, could you please tell me if you have been experiencing any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had pain in my wrist; it’s mostly stiffness in my arm and reduced shoulder movement that’s been bothering me.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a clearer picture of what’s going on, could you please check your arms for me? Have you noticed any skin lesions, such as rashes, bumps, or marks, running along the path of your veins?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or marks along the veins of my arm. The main thing is the stiffness and reduced range of motion in my shoulder, which makes daily tasks like combing my hair and reaching overhead difficult.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, I’d like to ask about your breathing: Do you find that you experience shortness of breath or difficulty catching your breath when you are physically active, such as walking or climbing stairs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been feeling short of breath when walking or climbing stairs—I’m mostly just noticing the stiffness and limited range of motion in my arm and shoulder making daily activities harder.”
